case.title: SSL KOLKATA fire and grounding off the Sundarbans
case.subRegion: Off Sagar Island / Sundarbans, West Bengal

incident.positionSource: APPROXIMATE: sources say 7-8 nm off the Sundarbans; exact coordinates not public. Refine from Sentinel-1 scene of 17 Jul 2018.

oil.spilledNote: SkyTruth observed a 17 km slick from the wreck in Sentinel-1 imagery on 17 July 2018; HFO offloaded by 18 Sep 2018.

anchors.event: Explosion in cargo hold, fire (2250 hrs)
anchors.source: DG Shipping press release; position approximate

anchors.event: Still aground; slick spreading north and south

vessels.name: LEWEK HARRIER
vessels.note: AIS showed the tug visiting the wreck by 19 July 2018

observations.description: 17 km slick from the vessel pushed by Ganges delta currents (Sentinel-1)
Slick spreading south and north toward the delta (Sentinel-2)

timeline.event: Explosion and fire in cargo area; 22 crew rescued by ICG
17 km slick visible in Sentinel-1 imagery
Heavy fuel oil offloaded by salvors

case.officialFindings: OSRL assessments reported no oil reached the Sundarbans; SkyTruth imagery shows offshore slick from the wreck.
